summary: St. Joe National Forest site at 6,762 ft: a 1924 camp with an L-4 tower built 1933; last staffed 1972; burned by lightning in 1984. No source describes what remains.

facts.design: L-4 tower built 1933; set atop a concrete base in 1953
facts.status_note: Burned by lightning in 1984 per the Idaho page; the page does not say what remains of the tower or its base
